kind: Frozen effective recorded mid-to-side linear transfer, not a recovered physical BBD circuit

v3_profile.kind: recording-calibrated effective stereo transfer; not recovered PSS-780 schematic
v3_profile.method: Given observed mid, predict side using one globally periodic delay, fixed gain and fixed mid leakage. Equal-RMS weighting per training preset. No per-window phase, gain, or timing fit. Fit on 100–4000 Hz bandpassed 48 kHz signals. Delay is an effective transfer delay, not a direct BBD delay measurement.
v3_profile.time_origin: Seconds from beginning of decoded reference audio. The phase is a capture coordinate; no claim of hardware reset phase.
limitations: Stereo video is lossy and capture processing is not known.
Observed mid is not proven to be the raw unfiltered mono chip signal.
Delay and mid leakage describe an effective transfer, not identified physical parts.
Measured phase is specific to this capture; synthesizer demos may choose a new phase.
Baseline comparison below uses old quasi-static delay/gain approximation, not a complete BBD re-render.

correction_blend.kernel: Autocorrelation of prototype, normalized maximum response <=1 with 1e-6 margin; 2049 taps at 48kHz
correction_blend.purpose: Apply linear correction only near calibrated band; smoothly return toward frozen v3 elsewhere

latency: Offline two-sided operation with no output delay; real-time implementation requires equal whole-stereo latency for lookahead
limitations: Observed mid is not proven dry; fitted response can include channel imbalance, recorder and codec effects.
Retaining input mid is by construction, not a hardware routing claim.
No physical component values, input volts, BBD distortion or DAC precision recovered.
All evaluation material was previously observed; no fresh independent hardware holdout.
